from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Represents one provided paper: its title and which other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as extracted from the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that are cited in this document's reference list. Only include titles from the known collection.")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates the extracted information from all provided documents."""
    papers: list[Paper]
